column1: Justification: Cooling water pump skid overhaul during the November shutdown.

column10: Hex nut 11mm brass for the instrument air manifold fixings. Supply with matching washers. Batch certificate required with each lot.
Dowel pin 3mm stainless A4-80 for coupling guard alignment. Supply to ISO 2338 tolerance m6. Batch certificate required.
Hex head bolt 4mm stainless A2-70 for junction box and cover fixing. Supply with matching nuts and washers. Batch certificate required.
Carbide reamer 4mm for the maintenance workshop, used to finish bearing housings during the shutdown. Supply in protective sleeves.
PCD reamer 2mm for fine finishing of instrument port bores. Supply with runout test report.
Water miscible anti-seize compound for stainless flange bolting on the cooling water header. Supply in 5 litre containers with material safety data sheet.
Stretch film for palletising the shutdown spares in the stores. Supply in 500 mm rolls.
